# Quarter Cluster

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Everything the system produces about a single quarter — its plan, log, review, journal and health notes — taken as one whole rather than many notes of one kind.

## Scope note

The quarterly rung of the roll-up. Its five parts are the same five MonthCluster and YearCluster carry, so a reader who knows one knows all three.
